title: A Safehouse for the Cover
author: V. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Wren Nakamura, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
